About Facilitation Cost Rates
  • Rates are based on the facilitator's Monthly Cost Basis.
  • Hourly Rate is calculated using the Costing Basis above.
  • The rate effective on the training date is the one used for that session's cost.
  • Completed trainings keep the rate used at the time of completion, for audit purposes.
🔒 Restricted Access
Cost data is reliable from August 2026 onward. Earlier months may show incomplete or skewed figures due to sessions not yet marked Completed, missing attendance records, or facilitator rate history not backdated far enough. Treat pre-August numbers as directional only.
Scheduled = every session in this period regardless of status · Completed = only the realized subset already tagged Completed

Log Report as Already Submitted

For sessions whose report was already submitted outside the app (e.g. via email) before this workflow existed. This skips the usual Attendance & Performance and report-field requirements — just record when it was submitted and where to find it.

⚠️ Reminder: this skips attendance validation. If attendance for this session hasn't been marked yet, please go to Attendance & Performance > Tag Complete first — otherwise the roster will stay incomplete even after this report is logged.
